intro: The Lord of Blackrock is an Alliance quest initiated upon claiming the severed head of the black dragon Nefarian within Blackwing Lair. Delivering this monstrous trophy to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind Keep announces the downfall of the master of Blackrock Mountain. It marks one of the greatest military triumphs the Alliance has celebrated in recent history.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The old feeling returns. The welcome pangs of victory reverberate throughout your being. Before you lies the monolithic, battle scarred head of Nefarian. Return it to your Highlord, champion.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You need not be told the meaning of what you have done, friend. This day will be recorded in the annals of history. A victory the likes of which has not been known to the Alliance for years - if ever!
